new_ops.name: alibi_attention
new_ops.reason: Causal softmax attention whose pre-softmax scores get a per-head linear distance penalty -m_h*(i-j) (query i, key j), with head slopes m_h = 2^(-8h/n), n = number of heads, h in 1..n (figure caption). The IR attention op has no ALiBi bias attribute; this needs an attention primitive that adds a [heads, T, T] distance bias before the softmax.
new_ops.quote: Instead of adding positional information to the embedding layer, ALiBi directly attenuates the attention scores based on how far away the keys and queries are \citep{press2021train}.
new_ops.where: Sec. Modeling Details, ALiBi Positional Embeddings

output.notes: Described the headline BLOOM 176B; the five smaller sizes are listed under configs. The text does not give the block wiring (pre/post norm, residual adds, final norm), which appears only in the architecture figure that is not readable from the LaTeX. The block above is a standard skeleton, and norm_placement and residual are not_stated. d_ff, head_dim, n_kv_heads, qkv bias and norm eps are not stated. GELU is listed without saying whether it is the exact or the tanh form, so the gelu approx attribute is not_stated. ALiBi slopes come from the Figure architecture_diagram caption. The embedding LayerNorm is an explicit deviation stated in the text. The smaller models were trained in float16 and the 176B in bfloat16.
